raw_comment:
I noticed that West Virginia and Ohio are on the Leeward Side of the Appalachian Mountains which is leading to a rain shadow being cast on those states. This is causing them to experience some of the highest levels of drought in the country. 

  

Is La Nina impacting these weather conditions in a substantial way?  

  

 The man-made lake near my house is extremely low and I am starting to see cinderblocks and parking curbs which are usually hidden beneath the water. This lake is used as a source of water for some nearby neighborhoods, if the drought continues to evaporate the lake while leaving the sediment behind, the water may become worse quality and contain harsher amounts of minerals.
